specialist_absence_fade_on_production.classification_evidence: Week-blocked interval crosses zero at the low end (-0.4357 to +2.2422 accuracy points), the expected shape for a real small signal; wrong_sign_resolved is inadmissible since the whole interval is not below zero. no_split_half_reliability is inadmissible: the flag is a deterministic function of a weekly report_status field plus a resolved wire IR-placement bracket, not a repeated psychological measurement. No positive-control bound applies (control read +44.298 points, P+ 1.0, proving the harness sensitive, not bounding this candidate's own magnitude).
specialist_absence_fade_on_production.description: FADE teams missing their long snapper or punter (weekly Out report or a confirmed wire IR-placement window), stacked on production weak_stack, opener grade, REFRESH-channel candidate
specialist_absence_fade_on_production.notes: docs/schedule_flag_battery.md Wave 7 section 21; late-week REFRESH-channel candidate (weekly injury report postdates Tuesday lock), not wired to a live overlay this session; 111/4,902 full-schedule flagged games, 47 weekly-Out team-weeks plus 13 resolved wire placement events. specialist_absence_fade_on_production.plain_summary: When a team is missing its long snapper or punter, this checks whether betting against that team pays off. The lean is positive (about 88% of resamples favour it) but the sample is still small.
